description: Connects your domain and its www subdomain to your published Kelas AI website by adding both ownership verification TXT records, IPv4 routing A records, and HTTPS certificate authorization CNAME records in one step.
variableDescription: %verify_token% and %www_verify_token%: unique ownership verification tokens issued by Kelas AI. %cert_host% and %www_cert_host%: per-project Google Certificate Manager label suffixes under _acme-challenge_. %cert_target% and %www_cert_target%: unique Google Certificate Manager DNS authorization targets under authorize.certificatemanager.goog.
